faq.title: FAQ
faq.heroSubtitle: Quick answers about shopping at Osool Altamaioz.
faq.q1Question: How do I search for a product?
faq.q1Answer: Use the search bar in the header or visit a category page. You can search by product name, model, or SKU.
faq.q2Question: Are prices shown on the website final?
faq.q2Answer: Official online selling prices are being confirmed. Where a price is not yet approved, the storefront shows Price unavailable.
faq.q3Question: How do I track my order?
faq.q3Answer: Use Track Order with your order number and email, or view orders in your account after login.
faq.q4Question: Do you ship across Saudi Arabia?
faq.q4Answer: Shipping zones and delivery times — BUSINESS_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED.
faq.q5Question: How do I create an account?
faq.q5Answer: Select Register, enter your details, and sign in to save addresses, wishlist, and order history.
faq.q6Answer: In development environments only, a test payment mode may be enabled for order flow verification. Real payment gateways are not active yet.
